description: Defines the 'codebook_config' structure and related nested structures and enums for configuring Type-I and Type-II codebooks in 3GPP NR specifications, including parameters for antenna ports, codebook modes, and restrictions.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for Type-I and Type-II codebooks, including nested types for single and multi-panel configurations, restrictions, and parameters.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type1
classes.description: Represents Type-I codebook configuration, including single and multi-panel subtypes and mode.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type1::single_panel
classes.description: Configuration for Type-I SinglePanel codebook, including antenna port restrictions and RI restrictions.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type1::multi_panel
classes.description: Configuration for Type-I MultiPanel codebook, including restriction types and RI.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type2
classes.description: Represents Type-II codebook configuration, including subtypes for 'typeii' and 'typeii_port_selection', with parameters for phase, subband amplitude, and beams.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type2::typeii
classes.description: Type-II codebook subtype with restrictions on n1-n2 codebook subset and RI.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type2::typeii_port_selection
classes.description: Type-II port selection configuration with optional port sampling size and RI restriction.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for comparing nested structures such as 'more_than_two_antenna_ports', 'single_panel', 'multi_panel', 'typeii', and 'typeii_port_selection'.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality operator for comparing nested structures.
